title: Collect phone number at sign-in, remove ✅ emoji from Confirm Booking button, fix Book Online redirect, show all user data in admin panel

requirements.summary: Collect phone number during first-time sign-in via ProfileModal and display it in the admin panel
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileModal includes a required phone number input field
Phone number is submitted and saved to the backend user profile via registerUser
Admin panel displays the stored phone number for each user
Phone number field is validated (numeric, reasonable length)

file_operations.description: The modal already collects name, phone, and service area. Verify that the phone field includes proper validation (numeric, reasonable length such as 10-15 digits) and that it is marked as required. Ensure the phone value is passed correctly to the useRegisterUser mutation hook.

Update the Users tab to display the phone number column for each registered user. The backend interface already returns phone as part of UserProfile via getUsers(). Add a table column or card field showing userProfile.phone for each user entry fetched from the backend.

requirements.summary: Remove the ✅ emoji from the 'Confirm Booking' button label
acceptanceCriteria: The Confirm Booking button contains no ✅ emoji anywhere in its label or children

file_operations.description: Locate the 'Confirm Booking' button element in the form submission section and remove any ✅ emoji from its label or children. Ensure the button text reads exactly 'Confirm Booking' with no emoji characters.

requirements.summary: Fix 'Book Online' button on ServiceCard to navigate to a dedicated /booking page with the full booking form
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Book Online' on any ServiceCard navigates to a /booking route
The /booking route renders a full booking form
The booking form is functional and submits correctly
Navigation back to the main page is available from the booking page

file_operations.description: Replace the 'Book Online' label or button with a clickable element that uses React Router's Link or useNavigate to navigate to '/booking'. Ensure the entire card or button triggers navigation when clicked.

Create a new BookingPage component that renders the full booking form. Extract the form logic and fields from BookingFormSection.tsx (name, phone, service selection, date/time, address, issue description, FormSubmit submission) into this dedicated page. Include a back navigation link or button to return to the home page. Style consistently with the existing dark theme and fade-in animations.

Register the /booking route in the router configuration. Import the new BookingPage component and add a Route element that renders BookingPage at path='/booking'. Ensure the route is accessible without authentication if the existing booking form is publicly accessible.

requirements.summary: Update Admin panel to display comprehensive user data including phone number, principal ID, service area, and registration time for all registered users
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel Users tab shows name, phone number, principal ID, service area, and registration timestamp for every registered user
All user records fetched from backend are displayed in a table or card list
Backend admin query returns phone number as part of user profile data
Admin panel is only accessible to the designated admin principal

file_operations.description: Expand the Users tab display to show all user profile fields: name (userProfile.name), phone number (userProfile.phone), principal ID (user principal toString()), service area (userProfile.area), and registration timestamp (userProfile.signupTime converted to readable date format). The backend getUsers() already returns Array<[Principal, UserProfile]> with all required fields including phone. Present the data in a table with columns for each field or as detailed cards. Ensure the admin panel remains protected by the existing authorization checks.
